items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: He was also of the Syncopated Orchestra. And we had Pierre de Caillaux on piano...

ctx.x: He was also of the Syncopated Orchestra. And we had Pierre de Caillaux on piano, George Jones on violin, Fred Coxito on alto-saxophone and that's about all. Benny Peyton on drums.
